items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: INTERVIEWER: did you know Steve Lewis who played piano with Piron? INTERVIEWEE: No, offhand I didn't.

ctx.x: I thought Jimmy Dupree wrote that. Oh no, no, Jimmy Dupree. Wrote the words or something. No. Jimmy Dupree used to write all lyrics. Yeah, lyrics, that's what I mean.
Yeah, he wrote all the lyrics, yeah. And what about, did you know Steve Lewis who played piano with Piron?
No, offhand I didn't. Yeah. With Piron, he used to play at Spanish Ford, at Pontchartrain Beach in those days. Yeah. And he had a very good orchestra, and he wrote this, Pueblo Rose of Cairo.
